checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and the itemized prices begin on page 1. On the same page counts as placed correctly.
The includes text lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery and crematory. The list covers the principal services.
The list shows a separate charge for handling a casket bought elsewhere. The text presents it as an added fee tied to an outside purchase.
checks.quote: Casket Handling Fee (applies when a casket is purchased elsewhere)

checks.explanation: The embalming disclosure is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1. Same-page placement counts as correct.
The list states that embalming is required before any cremation by the firm. That includes direct cremation arrangements.
checks.quote: Please note: state law requires embalming before any cremation performed by our firm.

checks.explanation: The alternative-container disclosure is on page 2 and the direct cremation prices are on page 2. Same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states that a casket is needed for direct cremation. The direct cremation options include purchaser-provided and fiberboard containers.
The direct cremation description includes transportation to crematory and cremation. No separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines. Package components also have itemized lines.
The package states each item is also available separately at the prices above. Its components have itemized prices on the list.
The list states that state law requires embalming before any cremation by the firm. That is a statement that law requires a purchase.
checks.quote: Please note: state law requires embalming before any cremation performed by our firm.

checks.explanation: The list describes sealed burial vaults as protecting from water and the elements for generations. That is a long-term protection claim.
checks.quote: Our sealed burial vaults protect your loved one from water and the elements for generations to come.

checks.explanation: The required embalming disclosure says embalming is usually not required by law. The other statement that embalming is required before any cremation undercuts that message.
checks.quote: Please note: state law requires embalming before any cremation performed by our firm.
